tokens.name: window-bg
tokens.usage: Content area of the launcher window, behind form sections and the preview.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Sidebar column and the bottom action bar.

tokens.name: titlebar-bg
tokens.usage: Native caption and the game tab strip under it.

tokens.name: group-bg
tokens.usage: Cards: FormSection boxes and the preview cards.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: Card outlines and the row separators inside them.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and pop-up buttons.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and pop-up buttons under the pointer.

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Text and number fields, if one is added (the launcher itself uses sliders).

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: Slider tracks, bar tracks and the segmented control.

tokens.name: segment-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: A switch turned off: 3:1 against its card.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Slider and switch knobs.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text on window-bg, sidebar-bg, group-bg, control-bg, field-bg and segment-track.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: FormSection titles.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Row descriptions and values beside their names.

tokens.name: label-muted
tokens.usage: Group labels, eyebrows and footers: 4.5:1 on the cards.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and controls only.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between form rows, around section boxes and between window regions. Decorative, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of fields and the slider knob in the light theme. Decorative: control-bg and knob set controls apart.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent text and icons. The game tab replaces it with its own palette.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, slider fills, switches: white on it is 4.5:1. The game tab replaces it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-fill: 4.7:1 or more on every game's accent-fill.

tokens.name: support-fill
tokens.usage: The Support on Ko-fi button, with on-accent text and a heart: 4.8:1.

tokens.name: sidebar-selection
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row, as a 16% tint.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring 3px outside the control.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ready state text and glyph on success-bg or group-bg. Always paired with a check glyph and a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge fill for the success tone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and glyph on warning-bg or group-bg, e.g. eye tracker not detected.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge fill for the warning tone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors and failure states on danger-bg, group-bg or window-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge fill for the danger tone.

tokens.name: preview-canvas
tokens.usage: The well behind the preview drawings.

tokens.name: preview-periphery
tokens.usage: Outer (peripheral) view area in FoveationPreview.

tokens.name: preview-focus
tokens.usage: Inner (focus) view area and its pixel grid in FoveationPreview.

tokens.name: overlay-teal
tokens.usage: UI swatch for the teal focus outline. Shown with its name, never alone.

tokens.name: overlay-magenta
tokens.usage: UI swatch for the magenta focus outline. Shown with its name, never alone.

tokens.name: overlay-green
tokens.usage: UI swatch for the green focus outline. Shown with its name, never alone.

tokens.name: preview-label
tokens.usage: Text and gaze marker on preview-canvas and preview-periphery.

tokens.name: traffic-close
tokens.usage: Close button in the macOS-style title bar. Decorative; the control also has an accessible name.

tokens.name: traffic-minimize
tokens.usage: Minimize button in the macOS-style title bar.

tokens.name: traffic-zoom
tokens.usage: Zoom button in the macOS-style title bar.

families.system: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Pane title at the top of the content area.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row labels, control text, sidebar items, game tabs. The default size for the whole launcher.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Draws a colored border around the focus region.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: FormSection footers, captions and pane eyebrows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; stepper arrows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; vertical padding of form rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside form rows and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a section box and its footer; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Content-area margins (the macOS window margin).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Content-area margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the form column and the preview column.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: Checkbox well.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, pop-up buttons, fields, segments, sidebar rows, game tabs.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: FormSection cards and the preview cards.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Launcher window corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: StatusBadge pill and outline-color swatches.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, pop-ups, fields and segments: a 34px target.

tokens.name: control-height-large
tokens.usage: The Launch button only.

tokens.name: row-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a FormRow.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed sidebar width.

tokens.name: preview-width
tokens.usage: Preview column width.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: Title bar height, including traffic-light padding.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: The game tab strip under the caption.

tokens.name: actionbar-height
tokens.usage: The bottom action bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-row-height
tokens.usage: A sidebar row.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Raised controls: buttons, pop-ups, the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The launcher window as a whole. Nothing else casts a shadow.

games.usage: One palette per game tab. While a tab is chosen its colours replace accent, accent-fill, on-accent and focus-ring. accent-fill carries white text at 4.5:1 or more; accent is text on the cards at 4.5:1 or more.
